name: Blood Oath
description: On an ally, split incoming damage equally with the caster. On an enemy, echo damage suffered by the caster to the linked enemy. Lasts 30 base seconds. One oath per caster.

name: Banish
description: Banish a target for 8 base seconds: invisible, untargetable, immobile, unable to act or deal/receive damage. Returns at the same position without recreating the entity.

name: Unstable Plague
description: Deals 2 base nature damage each second for 12 base seconds. If the host dies, jumps to the nearest enemy within 8 blocks, refreshing its duration and adding 2 base damage per tick. No artificial transfer or damage cap.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: A long piercing lightning beam deals 35 base damage to each enemy along its 60-block path. Solid terrain stops it. Each victim is hit once per cast.

name: Armageddon
description: Devastates a 45-block radius around you with 40 base fire damage and a 20-second burn for 3 base damage per second. You receive the burn, never the initial blast. Roughly 300 feet across.

name: Conjure Mana Gem
description: Conjures an edible Mana Gem that restores half its conjuration mana cost (100 to conjure / 50 restored by default). The refund is fixed when conjured. Only one usable gem per conjurer, even if dropped, stored or transferred.

name: Living Bomb
description: Burns a target for 2 base damage per second, then explodes after 6 seconds for 25 base fire damage in 5 blocks. Nearby enemies also burn for 6 seconds; those secondary burns never explode. Early death triggers the primary blast.

name: Mark
description: Records your location on the unstackable Travel Mark held in your offhand. Carry any number of marks; the selected offhand item determines the destination.

name: Teleport
description: Teleports you to the safe destination recorded on your offhand Travel Mark. The mark is not consumed.

name: Gate Travel
description: Opens a one-way gate nearby for 30 base seconds. Players entering it travel to your offhand Travel Mark. The mark is not consumed.

name: Twin Gates
description: Opens linked two-way gates between here and your offhand Travel Mark for 30 base seconds. A shared transit cooldown prevents immediate bouncing back.

name: Conjure Cannonball
description: Conjures a fast flying cannonball for 25 base blunt damage. Impact splashes other enemies within 3 blocks for half damage. Requires no firearm.

name: Conjure Bullet
description: Conjures a very fast bullet for 12 base piercing damage to the first enemy or obstacle hit. Requires no firearm.

name: Blizzard
description: Hold your staff to rain large ice shards onto the ground where you aim. Enemies within 8 blocks take 3 base frost damage every half-second and move 40% slower. Releasing or moving stops the storm. Range: 32 blocks. Costs 20 mana plus 10 per second; lasts up to 12 seconds.

name: Starfall
description: With a staff, hold to channel stars over a 24-block radius around you. Every 0.2 seconds, one random enemy takes 6 base arcane damage. Repeat hits are allowed. Costs 30 mana to begin and 15 per second. Maximum 15 seconds; releasing or moving ends the channel.

name: Rust Sentry
description: Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing rust bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.

name: Fire Sentry
description: Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing fire bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.

description: Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing water bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.

name: Wind Sentry
description: Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing wind bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.

name: Earth Sentry
description: Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing earth bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.

name: Lightning Sentry
description: Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds, firing lightning bolts at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.

name: Arcane Sentry

name: Rock Sentry
description: Summons a stationary 30-HP goober for 90 base seconds. Throws blunt-damage rocks at nearby enemies every 1.5 seconds. One sentry per caster.
